`enum DrawMode`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.render.tessellator` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [DrawMode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/render/tessellator/DrawMode.java)

How the `Tessellator` joins the vertices you give it into lines or triangles.

## Learn more

- [Framebuffers and models](/use/learn/going-further/framebuffers-and-models/)
- [Drawing shapes and text](/use/learn/going-further/drawing/)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`LINES`](#DrawMode-value-LINES) | Each pair of vertices is one segment. |
| [`LINE_STRIP`](#DrawMode-value-LINE_STRIP) | Each vertex is joined to the next one, an open line. |
| [`LINE_LOOP`](#DrawMode-value-LINE_LOOP) | Each vertex is joined to the next one, and the last one to the first, a closed line. |
| [`TRIANGLES`](#DrawMode-value-TRIANGLES) | Each group of three vertices is one triangle. |
| [`QUADS`](#DrawMode-value-QUADS) | Each group of four vertices is one quad, drawn as two triangles. |
| [`POLYGON`](#DrawMode-value-POLYGON) | The vertices form one convex polygon, drawn as a fan of triangles from the first vertex. |
